design_archetype: ARCHETYPE 1 & 4 FUSION: Soft Fintech & Precision Swiss (Indian SMB Tailored)
target_audience: Indian Small & Medium Business Owners (Khata/PagarBook style simplicity) & Employees on Smartphones

theme.brand_identity: Trustworthy Emerald & Deep Sapphire Fintech with Warm Sand Canvas

typography.anti_default_rule: PROHIBITED from using Inter or Roboto for Main Headings or Section Headers. Main headings must use 'Outfit' with tight letter spacing.

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900 leading-none
hierarchy.h2_section: text-xl sm:text-2xl lg:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900
hierarchy.caption: text-xs font-medium text-slate-500 tracking-wide uppercase

status_pills.present: bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 dark:text-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-800
status_pills.absent: bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border-rose-200 dark:bg-rose-950/40 dark:text-rose-300 dark:border-rose-800
status_pills.half_day: bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border-amber-200 dark:bg-amber-950/40 dark:text-amber-300 dark:border-amber-800
status_pills.pending: bg-sky-50 text-sky-700 border-sky-200 dark:bg-sky-950/40 dark:text-sky-300 dark:border-sky-800
status_pills.overtime: bg-purple-50 text-purple-700 border-purple-200 dark:bg-purple-950/40 dark:text-purple-300 dark:border-purple-800

layout_patterns.mobile_first_philosophy: Every screen must render seamlessly on a 360px wide phone viewport (single column grid, fixed bottom mobile navigation, thumb-friendly tap targets min 44px).

owner_portal.nav_structure: Top company selector pill + quick notifications + profile avatar. Bottom navigation bar on mobile (Dashboard, Attendance, Directory, Payroll, More). Sidebar layout on desktop.
owner_portal.hero_widget: Owner Summary Deck: Headcount active, Today's Present/Absent/Late counts, Monthly Payroll liability in ₹, Pending Leave Approvals queue counter.
owner_portal.grid_mode: Bento density grid (col-span-1 for summary KPIs, col-span-2 or 3 for salary trends/attendance bar charts).

employee_portal.nav_structure: Simplified bottom nav bar for mobile (Home, Self Check-in, Leave, Payslips).
employee_portal.hero_widget: Big Actionable 'Punch In / Punch Out' Card with Real-time Clock, GPS location status badge, and Camera selfie preview overlay.
employee_portal.quick_stats: Leaves Remaining gauge, Monthly Attendance summary progress bar, Latest Payslip quick view button.

multi_company_switch.component: Shadcn DropdownMenu / Select with company logo avatar, GSTIN sub-label, and 'Add New Business' action.

attendance_facial_and_gps.selfie_capture_modal: Live video canvas stream with oval face guide overlay, geotagged location indicator (Latitude, Longitude & Address name), and one-tap 'Confirm Selfie Punch' button.
attendance_facial_and_gps.geofence_status: Pill badge displaying 'Inside Office Geofence (10m radius)' in green or 'Remote / Field Location' in amber.

employee_directory_csv.features: Search by name/department/role, view filter toggles (Active/Resigned/Contract), CSV bulk upload modal with dropzone and column mapper preview table.

payroll_engine_india.compliance_components: Explicit breakdowns for PF (Provident Fund @ 12%), ESI (Employees' State Insurance), PT (Professional Tax by state), and TDS (Tax Deducted at Source).
payroll_engine_india.run_payroll_stepper: 3-step Wizard: 1. Review Attendance & Lop (Loss of Pay), 2. Preview Salary Structure & Adjustments/Bonuses, 3. One-click Approve & Mark Paid with Bank Transfer / UPI Export log.

payslip_pdf_generation.view: Mobile & Desktop print-ready HTML/PDF preview modal complete with company header, employee UAN/ESI numbers, itemized earnings/deductions table, net payable in INR words, and downloadable PDF action button.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-800/80
visual_enhancers.tactile_cards: rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-800/80 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200
visual_enhancers.gradient_accents: Avoid dark color full gradients. Use subtle highlight accents like 'bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-500 to-teal-600' strictly on primary CTA buttons or subtle top accent borders.

image_urls.description: Six Indian business colleagues in an office meeting collaborating on laptops
Indian business founder using laptop for HR management

motion.micro_interactions: Smooth active press scales on buttons (whileTap={{ scale: 0.98 }}), slide-up drawer entrance for mobile modals, hover soft lift (-translate-y-0.5) on stats cards.

testing_and_data_testids.rule: ALL interactive buttons, inputs, tabs, modals, and key financial metric text containers MUST feature unique kebab-case data-testid attributes.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.1: DO NOT use generic centered text or default Inter font for headlines. Use Google Font Outfit for headings and DM Sans for body.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.2: All inputs and form controls must use Shadcn primitive components (Select, Checkbox, RadioGroup, Dialog, Sheet, Tabs, Switch, Table, Input).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.3: Always display currency amounts formatted in Indian Rupees (₹) with proper Indian numbering system (e.g. ₹1,50,000 instead of ₹150,000).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.4: Ensure full responsiveness on mobile viewports (360px+) with fixed bottom tab bar navigation for mobile devices.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.5: Provide seamless switching between Owner/Admin mode and Employee mode with quick demo toggle for easy testing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.6: Use Sonner for toast notifications on success/error actions (e.g. 'Attendance marked successfully', 'Payroll generated for July 2026').
